summary: Master conflict of interest management with ISO 31000, SEC/FINRA compliance, and AI-driven risk assessment. 5-day intermediate course for Compliance Officers an
lede: Conflict of interest management helps professionals identify, assess and address situations where personal interests could affect work decisions. This training is for people in compliance, governance, procurement, financial services and operations who handle these risks in day-to-day work. It covers disclosure and recusal procedures, risk assessment, and safeguards such as separation of duties and independent review, with exercises in procurement, financial conflicts and audit preparation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate professionals who manage conflict of interest risks daily in compliance, governance, procurement, financial services, or operations roles.
modules: Foundations of Conflict of Interest in Modern Governance
COI Risk Assessment and Data-Driven Detection
Core COI Mitigation Strategies: Disclosure, Recusal, and Safeguards
Supporting COI Strategies: Upstream, Downstream, and Circular Contexts
COI Compliance, Standards, and External Stakeholder Engagement
COI Integration, Strategy, and Executive Communication
COI in Procurement and Vendor Management
COI in Financial Services: Trading, Advisory, and Regulatory Reporting
prerequisites: No formal prerequisites are required, but you should have working knowledge of basic ethics frameworks (e.g., COSO, ISO 37001) and familiarity with your organization’s COI policy. Pre-course preparation includes reviewing your company’s COI disclosure form and identifying one real COI scenario to use in exercises. No coding or advanced technical skills are needed.
